title: Placement
description: Free region of the osu! screen to sit in. auto: osu!/catch right of the playfield (low, clear of the default key counter), taiko under the lane (left), mania right of the stage with its receptor line. left/right pick the other side band; bottom = under the playfield (osu!/catch) or lane (taiko); top = above the taiko lane. Results always use the free right part of the header strip.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the keys right (positive) or left on the 1920×1080 screen, for skins that place things differently.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the keys down (positive) or up.

title: Scale
description: Overall size, 0.5–2. The keys also shrink automatically when they would not fit their region (e.g. many mania keys).

title: Orientation
description: Horizontal: a row of key caps with the KPS tile beside it (or above it when the region is narrow). Vertical: a column of caps with the KPS tile below.

title: Cap size / px
description: Edge length of each key cap; 48–96.

title: Show KPS history
description: Bars of keys per second over the last 10 s; on the results screen, the whole attempt with its peak marked.

title: Show total taps
description: Sum of all key counts for the attempt.

title: Backing
description: none: the caps float on the game. scrim: a soft dark fade behind them for very bright backgrounds. panel: an 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent colour
description: map: lit keys and the live KPS take the current map's colour (from its background, which is never shown). 18-lab: amber. Taiko drum keys keep don amber / kat blue.

title: Mania column start
description: Override for the mania stage's left edge (skin ColumnStart). 0 = read from the current skin's skin.ini through vosu (osu!stable default 136 when unavailable).

title: Mania column width
description: Override for the mania column width (skin ColumnWidth). 0 = from the skin (default 30).

title: Mania caps match column width
description: Size the mania caps to the stage's column pitch so the row mirrors the stage.
